name: stalled_game_exploration
body: At GAME_OVER, use RESET before any other action. After resetting, compare each action's resulting frame and interior pixels with prior transitions. If the same action in the same apparent state gives no new interior state twice, stop retrying it; test a different action or position instead. Maintain a small ledger of attempted (state, action) pairs and prioritize untried pairs. Before spending another long sequence, inspect recent diffs and check whether progress is confined to an edge/UI pixel. Treat repeated SPACE without interior change as a stall, not evidence that more SPACE will help.
summary: Bound retries when game actions repeatedly fail to produce a new interior state.
